# RaggieSoft Installer Studio — Public Engineering Roadmap

**Product:** RaggieSoft Installer Studio (*Install Without Limits* — Flagship Pillar of **RaggieSoft Studio**)  
**Official Suite Portal:** [https://raggiesoftstudio.com](https://raggiesoftstudio.com) • **Editions Matrix:** [EDITIONS_AND_RAGGIESCRIPT.md](EDITIONS_AND_RAGGIESCRIPT.md) • [https://raggiesoftstudio.com/installer-studio/editions](https://raggiesoftstudio.com/installer-studio/editions) • **Visual Tour:** [https://raggiesoftstudio.com/installer-studio/screenshots](https://raggiesoftstudio.com/installer-studio/screenshots) • **Web Roadmap:** [https://raggiesoftstudio.com/installer-studio/roadmap](https://raggiesoftstudio.com/installer-studio/roadmap)  
**License:** MIT License (Open-Source Technical Preview)

## Core Engineering Charter & `v1.0.0 GA` North Star

1. **The `v1.0.0 GA` Dogfood North Star**: Version `1.0.0` is defined by a concrete real-world bar—reaching the exact milestone where **100% of RaggieSoft's own Windows desktop applications, classic VB6 utilities (*StoreTrainer*), interactive novels, and supporter audio archives** are packaged, signed, updated, and distributed exclusively with **RaggieSoft Installer Studio**.
2. **Zero Third-Party Runtime Dependencies**: Every binary in the suite (`InstallerStudio.exe`, `instbuild.exe`, `SetupWizard.exe`, `msiprism.exe`, and `RaggieSoftHelp.exe`) is compiled as static `/MT` native Win32 C++20 for both **`x64`** and **`ARM64`**—relying solely on stock Windows 11 `System32` libraries (`msi.dll`, `cabinet.dll`, `gdiplus.dll`, and `Msftedit.dll`).
3. **100% WCAG 2.2 Level AA & Live OS Theme Support**: Full keyboard navigation, native Windows UI Automation semantics (`Narrator`, `NVDA`, `JAWS`), Windows Contrast Themes (`SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST`), custom-subclassed Dark Mode controls, 32-bit ARGB vector `SysTreeView32` hierarchies, live `WM_SETTINGCHANGE(ImmersiveColorSet)` Light/Dark hot-swapping, enforced WCAG contrast checks on custom publisher branding, and compiler-generated HTML5 **VPAT 2.5** conformance reports (`--emit-vpat`).
4. **First-Class AI Coding Agent Support**: Plain-text, comment-preserving `.rsip` projects, `.rsis` suites, and `.rsii` includes paired with compiler-emitted `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`, and `SKILL.md` specifications (`--emit-ai-spec`) so AI agents can author and validate installers from scratch.
5. **Official Four Editions (`Community` • `Essentials` • `Developer` • `Architect`) & `Community == 100% Architect Parity`**: **Community Edition** (free for hobbyists, solo creators, educators, students, non-profits, and open-source maintainers) permanently maintains **100% technical feature parity with Architect Edition**, with zero watermarks and 100% publisher-owned `VERSIONINFO` metadata, alongside clearly scoped commercial licenses (**Essentials**, **Developer**, and **Architect**; full matrix in [`EDITIONS_AND_RAGGIESCRIPT.md`](EDITIONS_AND_RAGGIESCRIPT.md)).
6. **Original Engineering Identity**: Built cleanly from first principles on documented Microsoft Windows APIs—standing strictly on its own merits with zero telemetry and zero cryptocurrency/blockchain bloat.

## Shipped Milestones (`v0.1.0` – `v0.5.1`)

- **`v0.5.1` — Outer `Setup.exe` `RequestedExecutionLevel` Stamping, UAC-Disabled (`EnableLUA = 0`) Admin Gate, De-Elevated Finish Launch, Per-Product Single-Instance Activation, Polite Cross-Product `Global\_MSIExecute` Auto-Queue & Windows 7+ Taskbar Progress**:
  - Added `[Package] RequestedExecutionLevel = asInvoker | highestAvailable | requireAdministrator` across `.rsip` manifests, `RswValidator.hpp`, `InstallerStudio.exe` (`Setup UAC Level` combo), and `RswBootstrapperPackager.hpp` (stamping a clean single-LCID `RT_MANIFEST` `#1` onto per-arch, Offline Universal, and Web Stub `Setup.exe` binaries), plus Explorer `IShellDispatch2` desktop-token de-elevation on **Finish -> Launch** when `SetupWizard.exe` runs elevated.
  - Added `QueryProcessPrivilegeState` (`EnableLUA` policy + `TokenElevation` + `CheckTokenMembership` for `BUILTIN\Administrators`) so Administrators with UAC turned off (`EnableLUA = 0`) install seamlessly in-process while Standard Users with UAC disabled get an immediate, accessible *"Administrator Privileges Required"* explanation.
  - Added `UpgradeCode`-keyed per-product single-instance activation (`Local\RaggieSoft.SetupUI.<Key>` + `SetupStub.<Key>` with permissive DACLs, `AllowSetForegroundWindow`, and UIPI-whitelisted `RegisterWindowMessageW` restore/focus) so re-clicking a running product's `Setup.exe` brings its existing window front and center, while launching a *different* product's `Setup.exe` opens concurrently and uses **`ExecuteMsiCallWithPoliteQueue` + `ScopedActiveMsiBeacon`** to pause politely (`TBPF_PAUSED` amber taskbar state + *"Waiting for <Other Product> Setup to finish installing..."*) and auto-resume when `Global\_MSIExecute` clears—eliminating MSI `Error 1618`.
  - Fixed `Error 1324` (`..` in `Directory.DefaultDir`) via pure lexical path slicing + post-build `ICE03` verification, centered UAC anchoring on `FullScreenBlue`/`FullScreenTeal`, multi-line `DT_WORDBREAK` prompt wrapping across `Wizard95` sheets, persistent `WS_EX_APPWINDOW` taskbar icons, and live Windows 7+ `ITaskbarList3` taskbar progress bars.
- **`v0.5.0` — 10 Selectable Wizard Styles (`FullScreenBlue` & `FullScreenTeal` `#008080` ACME Callback, `Wizard95`..`FluentMica`), Classic & Custom Setup Types (`Typical`/`Compact`/`Complete`/`Custom`), `[Billboard.*]` & Live WCAG 2.2 AA Auto-Contrast**:

  - Added `RswWcagContrast.hpp` (`SnapAccentToAccessibleBand` + `RSW055` compiler lint diagnostic + one-click `Auto-Fix WCAG` button and live contrast badge in `InstallerStudio.exe`) guaranteeing `>= 4.5:1` contrast vs. `#FFFFFF` button text and `>= 3.0:1` contrast vs. `#15203A` Dark Mode cards.
- **`v0.4.5` — Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing (Public Trust Authenticode), ARM64 `/dlib` Architecture Matching & Pre-Signed Stub Safety**:
  - Cryptographically signed 100% of **RaggieSoft Installer Studio** inner suite executables (`InstallerStudio.exe`, `instbuild.exe`, `SetupWizard.exe`, `msiprism.exe`, `RaggieSoftHelp.exe`), inner `.msi` databases (`x64` & `ARM64`), and outer installers (`raggiesoft-installer-studio-setup.exe`, `-offline-setup.exe`, `-x64-setup.exe`, and `-arm64-setup.exe`) with a verified **Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing** Public Trust certificate and RFC 3161 SHA-256 timestamp (`http://timestamp.acs.microsoft.com`).
  - Upgraded `LocateWindowsSdkSignTool` in `instbuild.exe` to inspect the PE `IMAGE_FILE_HEADER::Machine` of `Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib.dll` (`0x8664` `x64` vs. `0xAA64` `ARM64` vs. `0x014C` `x86`) and automatically invoke the matching Windows SDK `signtool.exe` architecture on Windows 11 `ARM64` workstations—preventing in-process `LoadLibraryW` `0x800700C1` (`ERROR_BAD_EXE_FORMAT`) mismatches.
  - Added `StripExistingPeCertificates` (`ImageEnumerateCertificates` / `ImageRemoveCertificate` via `imagehlp.dll`) prior to `BeginUpdateResourceW` so pre-signed `SetupWizard.exe` templates never leave dangling `IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY` offsets when stamping customer `Setup.exe` resources, plus CI/release `RSW_SIGN_*` environment-variable overrides.
- **`v0.4.4` — Plain-English Feature Inclusion Tiers (`Minimal`, `Typical`, `Complete`, `Hidden`) Replacing Raw `InstallLevel` Jargon**:
  - Replaced cryptic numeric Windows Installer `InstallLevel` inputs across `InstallerStudio.exe` (`Features` and `Components & KeyPaths` views) and `.rsip` manifests with a plain-English **`Included In` (`[Feature.<Id>] Inclusion`)** selector so authors never have to memorize MSI `INSTALLLEVEL` thresholds:
    - **`minimal` (*Minimal / Compact & All Setups*)** -> `Level = 1` (core application files installed in Minimal/Compact `INSTALLLEVEL=20`, Typical/Express `100`, and Complete `1000`).
    - **`typical` (*Typical / Express & Complete*)** -> `Level = 50` (standard recommended extras installed in Typical/Express and Complete, skipped in Minimal/Compact).
    - **`complete` (*Complete Only / Optional in Custom*)** -> `Level = 150` (optional bonus packs installed automatically in Complete or opted into inside the Custom `SelectionTree`).
    - **`hidden` (*Hidden / Conditional Only*)** -> `Level = 0` (excluded from `SelectionTree` unless conditionally enabled), while preserving 100% backward compatibility with explicit numeric `Level` overrides.
- **`v0.4.3` — Single-Download CPU-Aware Smart Web Stub & All-in-One Offline Universal Installer (`x64` + `ARM64` Combined)**:
  - Eliminated confusing separate `x64` vs. `ARM64` download choices for everyday Windows users by adding `BuildUniversal = true` (`--universal`) to `instbuild.exe`, `InstallerStudio.exe`, and `SetupWizard.exe`:
    - **Smart CPU-Aware Web Stub (`<Product>-setup.exe`)**: Compact static `/MT` Win32 C++20 `x64` launcher that starts natively on Intel/AMD PCs and via Prism on Windows 11 ARM64 PCs, calls `IsWow64Process2` to detect true host silicon in `< 0.1ms`, streams **only** the matching native `ARM64` or `x64` installer over HTTPS (`WinHTTP`) inside a Dark/Light/High-Contrast progress window, verifies its build-stamped **SHA-256** digest (`bcrypt.dll`), and hands off execution to the 100% native installer.
    - **Single-File Offline Universal EXE (`<Product>-offline-setup.exe`)**: Self-contained portable `.exe` bundling **both** `LZMS`-compressed `x64` and `ARM64` native installers in Win32 `RT_RCDATA` resources—extracting and launching the true native silicon installer automatically for air-gapped workstations, USB drives, and archival preservation while forwarding all CLI flags (`/s`, `/qn`, `--extract-msi`, `INSTALLDIR=...`).
- **`v0.4.2` — 12-View Tree-First Visual IDE Overhaul, Dedicated `Features` & `RegEdit` `Registry` Trees, Categorized `MSI Prism` Schema & Inspector Fixes**:
  - Replaced flat `LISTBOX` and `SysListView32` overuse across `InstallerStudio.exe`, `msiprism.exe`, and `RaggieSoftHelp.exe` with **20 anti-aliased 32-bit premultiplied ARGB vector tree icons (`StudioTreeIcon`)** and `ApplyDarkTreeViewTheme` (`DarkMode_Explorer` / `Explorer` chevrons, connector lines, and 24px accessible row height).

## Focused Milestones to `v1.0.0 GA` (Shipping RaggieSoft's Own Software)

### `v0.5.0` — 8 Wizard Layout Variations, Author-Defined Setup Types (`Typical` / `Compact` / `Complete`), Branding Studio & WCAG Contrast Enforcer
1. **Eight First-Party Wizard Layout Variations (`[UI] WizardLayout`) Spanning Every Era of Windows UX**:
   - **`Wizard95` (`wizard95`)**: Classic 1995 desktop 3D beveled dialog geometry (`#C0C0C0` surface, sunken etched dividers, `164x314` left vertical bitmap rail, and classic 3D beveled `< Back` / `Next >` / `Cancel` push buttons).
   - **`Wizard97` (`wizard97` / `standard`)**: Classic enterprise header-banner wizard with top banner + right-side emblem, crisp workspace sheet, and bottom-right `< Back` / `Next >` / `Cancel` footer—modernized for Dark Mode and Light Mode.
   - **`AeroWizard` (`aerowizard`)**: Command-bar layout with a vector GDI+ `30x30` circular `<-` Back glyph in the top-left command area (or author-selected bottom-right `< Back`).
   - **`FluentMica` (`fluentmica`)**: Modern Windows 11 native backdrop in zero-dependency Win32 C++20 via `DwmSetWindowAttribute(DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE, DWMSBT_MAINWINDOW / DWMSBT_TABBEDWINDOW)` with a unified borderless surface, left-hand vertical step-progress rail (`Welcome -> License -> Options -> Install -> Finish`), and rounded `8px` cards.
   - **`OneClickSplash` (`oneclick`)**: Friction-free single-card express installer (`~480x280`) with one primary **Install** button, live progress bar, and a *"Customize installation..."* disclosure button that expands into the full Custom Setup (`SelectionTree` + folder picker) flow on demand.
   - **`PassiveToast` (`passivetoast`)**: Clean non-interactive `/passive` & `/qb` progress surface (centered or docked near the bottom-right system tray) with UI Automation live-region percentage announcements.
   - **`FullScreenBlue` (`fullscreenblue` / `fullscreenteal`)**: Nostalgic 1990s full-screen `SETUP.EXE` backdrop supporting **both** the classic **Cobalt-Blue (`#000080 -> #000000`)** gradient wash and the classic **1995 Desktop Teal (`#008080`)** solid backdrop (the unmistakable mid-1990s Windows 95 / ACME-era setup look!), complete with a drop-shadowed serif product title in the top-left corner, floating 3D beveled setup dialogs, **optional rotating installation billboards**, and a floating **3D Beveled Progress Gauge** (centered or docked at the bottom-center / bottom-right beneath billboards—ideal for retro tools like *StoreTrainer*) while keeping modern DPI scaling, keyboard navigation, and UI Automation accessibility under the hood.
   - **`Autorun16x9` (`autorun16x9`)**: Widescreen `16:9` Collector's Edition & digital media launcher menu.
   - **Non-Negotiable Windows Contrast Theme Auto-Override (`SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST`)**: Across every `WizardLayout` and custom brand skin, whenever a Windows Contrast Theme (*Aquatic*, *Desert*, *Dusk*, *Night Sky*) is active, `SetupWizard.exe` automatically bypasses custom gradients, bitmaps, and Mica backdrops and paints strictly with semantic OS colors (`COLOR_WINDOW`, `COLOR_WINDOWTEXT`, `COLOR_HIGHLIGHT`, `COLOR_BTNTEXT`) and `2px` solid borders.
2. **Author-Defined Setup Types (`Typical`, `Compact`, `Complete`, `Custom`, & Custom `[SetupType.<Id>]` Presets)**:
   - Building on `v0.4.4`'s plain-English Feature `Inclusion` tiers (`minimal`, `typical`, `complete`, `hidden`), let authors switch between classic Windows 95-style presets (**Typical**, **Compact**, **Complete**, **Custom**) and modern presets (**Express**, **Compact**, **Custom**), OR define completely custom `[SetupType.<Id>]` options (such as *Developer Workstation*, *Minimal Portable*, *Classroom Lab*, or *Complete Archive*)—each with its own `&` keyboard mnemonic, vector badge, plain-English description, live disk-space estimate, and explicit `Features = ...` or `InclusionTier` mapping.
3. **Complete Publisher Branding & Live WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast Enforcer (`[Branding]` & `.rswskin`)**:
   - Customize Light & Dark Mode color palettes, header banners, `164x314` wizard sidebars, product badges, background washes, and rotating install billboards.
   - Every color picker in `InstallerStudio.exe` computes live W3C relative luminance contrast ratios across both Light and Dark palettes (`>= 4.5:1` AA normal text, `>= 3.0:1` large text & UI borders), displays live AA/AAA badges, and offers a one-click *"Auto-Adjust Nearest Accessible Shade"* button preserving brand hue—enforced identically in CI via `instbuild.exe --validate` and `--emit-vpat`.

### `v0.5.1` *(Shipped)* — Outer `Setup.exe` Manifest Execution Level (`asInvoker` | `highestAvailable` | `requireAdministrator`), UAC-Off Admin Checks, Single-Instance Focus & Cross-Product Auto-Queue
1. **Explicit Outer `Setup.exe` Manifest Execution Level (`[Package] RequestedExecutionLevel = asInvoker | highestAvailable | requireAdministrator`)**:
   - Gives installer authors a direct 3-way choice in `.rsip` manifests and the `InstallerStudio.exe` Visual IDE (`Package & Identity` -> `Setup UAC Level`) for stamping `<requestedExecutionLevel level="..."/>` into the outer `Setup.exe` Win32 `RT_MANIFEST` (`#1`):
     - **`asInvoker` *(Default)*:** Starts `SetupWizard.exe` in the caller's exact token (preserving unelevated **Finish -> Launch** Explorer drag-and-drop across UIPI, Standard User `%APPDATA%` profiles on Over-the-Shoulder IT prompts, and mapped network drives in **Browse...** pickers) and elevates `--elevated-msi-worker` when clicking **Install**.
     - **`highestAvailable`:** Requests elevation up front (`0.0s`) for Administrator accounts while still allowing Standard Users to open the wizard UI (ideal for dual-scope installers or deferring OTS credentials until **Install**).
     - **`requireAdministrator`:** Requires Administrator elevation immediately at `0.0s` launch (displaying the Windows Explorer shield overlay on `Setup.exe`), running prerequisites and `MsiInstallProductW` directly in-process with zero mid-wizard prompts—paired with Explorer `IShellDispatch2` shell-token delegation on **Finish -> Launch** for split-token Admin accounts.
2. **True Administrator Group Verification When UAC Is Turned Off (`EnableLUA = 0` + `CheckTokenMembership`)**:
   - Because disabling UAC (`EnableLUA = 0`) suppresses UAC prompts and causes `TOKEN_ELEVATION.TokenIsElevated` to report `0` on non-built-in accounts, `v0.5.1` verifies active `BUILTIN\Administrators` (`DOMAIN_ALIAS_RID_ADMINS`) group membership via Win32 `CheckTokenMembership` alongside MSI `Privileged` `LaunchCondition` enforcement when `Scope = machine`—allowing real Administrators with UAC disabled to install seamlessly while blocking non-admin Standard Users with a clear, accessible *"Administrator privileges required"* error whenever UAC cannot elevate.
3. **Per-Product Single-Instance Focus Handoff & Cross-Product Polite `Global\_MSIExecute` Auto-Queue**:
   - Double-clicking an already-running product's `Setup.exe` (`UpgradeCode` match) restores and foregrounds the existing setup window (`AllowSetForegroundWindow` + UIPI-whitelisted activation message) instead of spawning a second instance, while launching a *different* product's `Setup.exe` opens its wizard UI concurrently and politely auto-queues on `Global\_MSIExecute` (`ScopedActiveMsiBeacon` + amber `TBPF_PAUSED` taskbar state) instead of failing with MSI `Error 1618`.
4. **Compiler, Taskbar & Retro `Wizard95` / `FullScreenBlue` Hardening**:
   - Pure lexical payload subdirectory slicer + `.`/`..` segment sanitizer and post-build `ICE03` / `Error 1324` `Directory` verifier check, centered UAC anchoring on `FullScreenBlue`/`FullScreenTeal`, multiline `DT_WORDBREAK` text bounds across narrow `430px` `Wizard95` sheets, `WS_EX_APPWINDOW` taskbar icon preservation, and live Windows 7+ `ITaskbarList3` taskbar progress bar states.

### `v0.6.0` — Self-Extracting `.EXE` Builder (`PackageKind = sfx`), Disk Spanning & Loose Source Media (`msiexec /a`), `.rswpak` Packs, `.NET 11` & Multi-Engine Suite Setup *(Built & Privately Staged)*
1. **Lightweight Self-Extracting Archive `.EXE` Builder (`PackageKind = sfx` + Folder/ZIP-to-SFX AeroWizard + `%TEMP%` Software Installation Mode)**:
   - When a publisher or creator doesn't need Windows Installed Apps registration and simply wants a clean, accessible, zero-dependency **Self-Extracting `.EXE`** (compressed with Windows `LZMS`, Dark/Light/High-Contrast UI, selectable `asInvoker` / `highestAvailable` / `requireAdministrator` UAC levels), turn any folder or `.zip` archive into a portable `.exe` that extracts to a user-chosen directory and **optionally launches a bundled `.exe` (`PostExtractRun`) or opens a bundled document (`PostExtractOpen`, such as a `.pdf`, `.html`, `.txt`, or `.rtf` guide via `ShellExecuteExW` when the user has a compatible viewer installed)**.
   - **Software Installation `%TEMP%` Wrapper & Companion Process Watcher (`ExtractToTemp = true` + `CleanupTempAfterRun = true` + `WaitForProcess`)**: Unpack third-party or legacy multi-file setups into an isolated `%TEMP%\rsw-sfx-<Slug>-<PID>` staging folder, launch `PostExtractRun`, wait across both Win32 Job Object child trees and explicit companion cleanup processes (`WaitForProcess = _ISDEL.EXE; _INS*._MP`), and automatically clean up `%TEMP%` afterward.
2. **Multi-Volume Disk Spanning, Uncompressed Loose Source Media (`Run from CD-ROM` / `Run from Network`), & Administrative Installs (`msiexec.exe /a`)**:
   - **Multi-Volume Disk Spanning (`[Media] MaxCabinetSizeMB` + `CAB1.cab..CABN.cab`)**: Automatically split multi-gigabyte payloads across numbered external cabinets (`DiskId = 1..N` in the relational `Media` SQL table with customizable `VolumeLabel` and `DiskPrompt` change-media prompts) for removable drives, archival optical ISOs, and size-capped artifact hosts.
   - **Uncompressed Loose Source Files (`Compression = none | cab` + `Run from Media` / `Run from Network`)**: Emit uncompressed side-by-side source directory trees (`PID_WORDCOUNT` bit `1` + `msidbFileAttributesNoncompressed` `0x2000`) and `SourceOnly` / `Optional` component attributes (`MenuCD` & `MenuNetwork` in `SelectionTree`) so multi-gigabyte collector sets can run directly from optical/ISO media, USB drives, or UNC network shares without copying every asset onto local `C:\` storage.
   - **First-Class Administrative Installations (`msiexec.exe /a` Network Image Extraction)**: Full `AdminUISequence` (`AdminWelcomeDlg -> AdminInstallPointDlg -> ProgressDlg -> ExitDialog`) + `AdminExecuteSequence` support so IT administrators can extract clean, patchable uncompressed network installation points via `msiexec.exe /a Product.msi TARGETDIR="\\Server\Share\App"`.
3. **Granular On-Demand Feature Packs (`.rswpak`)**:
   - Building on `v0.4.3`'s CPU-aware Smart Web Stub and Combined Offline Universal Single-EXE, split optional multi-gigabyte features (high-DPI asset libraries, offline documentation packs, or language modules) into external LZMS-compressed `.rswpak` blocks fetched on demand via `WinHTTP` with SHA-256 + Authenticode verification when selected in `SelectionTree`.
4. **First-Class `.NET 11` (`net11.0` / `net11.0-windows`) Runtime Presets & Detection**:
   - Curated `DotNet11Desktop`, `DotNet11AspNet`, and `DotNet11Runtime` / `DotNet10Runtime` presets alongside `.NET 10.0 LTS`, `.NET 9.0`, and `.NET 8.0 LTS`, probing native `arm64` and `x64`-on-ARM64 installations in `< 1ms`.
5. **Native Direct Engine (`Engine = native | msi`), Unified Suite Setup (`.rsis` Chainer), & Dynamic `ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT` Takeover**:
   - Optional zero-`msi.dll` direct extraction backend with an atomic transactional rollback journal, `HKLM`/`HKCU` `Uninstall` registration, and a signed native `Uninstall.exe`—eliminating `Global\_MSIExecute` mutex collisions and installing multi-thousand-file interactive book and supporter audio packs in milliseconds.
   - **Unified Suite-Style Setup (`PackageKind = suite`) & Anti-Clutter `Installed apps` Governance**:
     - Standalone product installs leave `ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT` unset so individual products appear normally in Windows *Installed apps* / *Programs and Features*.
     - Installing a Suite (`2+` tools via `.rsis`) registers **one clean Suite Maintenance entry** (Visual Studio Installer model: **Add / Repair / Remove** individual tools) and sets `ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT=1` (`RS_SUITE_MANAGED=1`) across child `.msi` packages—including dynamically adopting any already-installed standalone sibling `.msi` via `REINSTALL=ALL REINSTALLMODE=vomus RS_SUITE_MANAGED=1` so *Installed apps* never gets cluttered with 8 separate entries, while flipping `ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT` back to `0` if a user detaches/keeps a standalone product during Suite removal.

### `v0.7.0` — `RaggieScript` (`RSWBC2` + Turnkey `RsDialog` Functions), Shared `RaggieSoftVisualCanvas` Dual WYSIWYG Dialog Designers & Non-Clobbering `[Environment.*]` `PATH` *(Built & Privately Staged)*
1. **`RaggieScript` (`.rssc`) `RSWBC2` Bytecode Container, `fmt` Formatter & Turnkey `RsDialog` Wizard Suite**:
   - Upgraded `RswRaggieScript.hpp` to emit `RSWBC2` SHA-256-verified bytecode (while retaining 100% `RSWBC1` backward compatibility) and added `raggiescript.exe fmt [--check]` + `Ctrl+Shift+F` in `InstallerStudio.exe` for canonical 4-space comment-preserving formatting.
   - **Turnkey `RsDialog` Function Suite (`RswRsDialogs.hpp` + `includes/raggiesoft-dialogs.rssc`)**: Lets authors wire multi-step Per-Monitor V2 DPI Dark/Light/High-Contrast wizards in single-line calls—`RsWelcome`, `RsLicense`, `RsReadme`, `RsUserInfo`, `RsSelectDestDir`, `RsSetupType`, `RsFeatureTree`, `RsAskOptions`, `RsAskText`, `RsReadyToInstall`, `RsFinish`, and `RsFinishReboot`—complete with `DialogResult.Next` (`1`), `DialogResult.Back` (`12`, triggering automatic `wizard { step ... }` history rewinding!), and `DialogResult.Cancel` (`2`).
2. **Shared Cross-Studio Visual Canvas SDK (`desktop-apps/studio-shared/include/RaggieSoftVisualCanvas.hpp`) & Dual WYSIWYG Dialog Designers**:
   - Extracted a zero-dependency C++20 2D authoring engine (`raggiesoft::studio::canvas`) shared across **Installer Studio**, **Showcase Studio**, **Launcher Studio**, and **Document Studio** (`LogicalViewport`, 8-grip resize hit-testing, grid snap, smart alignment hairlines, WCAG 2.2 AA `Arrow` / `Shift+Arrow` keyboard-only nudging, `#Tab` + `Alt+Key` mnemonic badges, and one-click `.rssc` code export).
   - **C++ `SetupWizard.exe` Page Designer (`[Dialog.<Id>]` + `[Control.<Id>]`)**: Visually place, drag, and resize `Text`, `Edit`, `PasswordEdit`, `PathEdit`, `CheckBox`, `RadioButtonGroup`, `ComboBox`, `ListBox`, `GroupBox`, and `Line` controls spliced after any built-in wizard step, with automatic `SecureCustomProperties` forwarding into `Product.msi`.
   - **Raw `370x270` DLU `MSI.DLL` SQL Dialog Designer (`[MsiDialog.<Id>]` + `[MsiControl.<Id>]`)**: Interactive `370x270` DLU canvas compiling directly into relational `Dialog`, `Control`, `ControlEvent`, `RadioButton`, `ComboBox`, and `ListBox` SQL tables with `TabOrder` sorting.
3. **Pulled Forward from `v1.1+`: Declarative Non-Clobbering `[Environment.<Id>]` (`PATH`) & `[IniFile.<Id>]` Across Both Engines**:
   - Added first-class `[Environment.<Id>]` (`Action = append_path | prepend_path | set | set_if_absent | remove`) compiling into MSI `Environment` (`=~*` + `[~];value` + `WriteEnvironmentStrings` / `RemoveEnvironmentStrings`) AND `Engine = native` (`MergePathSegmentNonClobbering` + `RemovePathSegmentNonClobbering` in `Uninstall.rswm` + `WM_SETTINGCHANGE`), plus `[IniFile.<Id>]` across both `Engine = msi` (`IniFile` table) and `Engine = native` (`WritePrivateProfileStringW`).

### `v0.8.0` — Solution & Legacy Project Importers (`.slnx`, VB6 `.vbp` Reg-Free COM & `.msi`) + Windows Restart Manager *(Next Feature Milestone)*
1. **Visual Studio `.slnx` / `.sln` / `.csproj` / `.vcxproj` / `CMakeLists.txt` Importer (Strictly Opt-In Pre-Package Build Hook)**:
   - Auto-detect `.NET 11` / `.NET 10 LTS` / `VC++` / `WebView2` runtime prerequisites, `x64` + `ARM64` publish outputs, `.ico` assets, and PE versions in one click.
   - **Opt-In Project Compilation (`[BuildHook] Enabled = false` by Default)**: Authors can *optionally* opt into having Installer Studio invoke `dotnet publish` / `MSBuild` prior to packaging, while keeping pre-build invocation **strictly Opt-In (off by default)** so packaging never triggers unexpected rebuilds unless requested.
2. **Visual Basic 6.0 (`.vbp`) Importer — Reg-Free COM by Default + Explicit `.MSM` Hazard Warning (Testbed: `desktop-apps/storetrainer/vb6-v1.1/TStore.vbp`)**:
   - Parse `ExeName32`, `Reference=`, and `Object=*.ocx` entries directly from `.vbp` projects while respecting Windows 11 Resource Protection (WRP) on built-in `SysWOW64` files (`msvbvm60.dll`, `stdole2.tlb`, `wshom.ocx`).
   - **Default to Zero-Elevation Registration-Free COM (`<App>.exe.manifest` SxS)**: Generates private side-by-side `<comClass>` / `<typelib>` manifests inside `[INSTALLDIR]` with zero `SysWOW64` or `HKCR` pollution.
   - **Optional `.MSM` Merge Module Fallback with Mandatory Warning & `F1` Documentation**: Allows selecting legacy `.MSM` Merge Modules when strictly required, while displaying a prominent IDE warning banner (and linking directly to `#vb6-regfree-com` in offline `F1` Help) explaining why global 32-bit COM Merge Modules cause `SysWOW64` reference-count drift, WRP conflicts, and forced UAC elevation.
3. **Existing `.msi` / `.msm` Decompiler & Windows Restart Manager (`Rstrtmgr.dll`)**:
   - Decompile existing `.msi`/`.msm` databases into editable `.rsip` projects, and integrate `RmStartSession` / `RmGetList` directly into `SetupWizard.exe` so upgrades gracefully close and restart running app processes without OS reboots.

### `v0.9.0` — Authenticode Signing Studio, Bundled `RsUpdate.exe` (100% DRY `apps-manifest.json`) + `RsPatch.exe` & Guided `.MSP` Servicing
1. **First-Class Authenticode & Azure Artifact Signing Studio**:

2. **Bundled White-Label Update Client (`RsUpdate.exe` — 100% DRY Shared Feed) & Binary Patching Client (`RsPatch.exe`)**:
   - **`RsUpdate.exe` (`[AutoUpdate]` — Shared `apps-manifest.json` Schema with RaggieSoft Launcher)**: Zero-dependency `/MT` Win32 C++20 update client (`x64` & `ARM64`, unlocked across all editions including Community!) consuming the **exact same JSON release manifest (`apps-manifest.json`)** already used by **RaggieSoft Launcher** (100% DRY Principle—publish one static JSON file on your CDN and both Launcher shelves and standalone `RsUpdate.exe` clients read it!). Runs zero background Windows Services, supporting on-demand checks plus an optional weekly Windows Scheduled Task (**explicit opt-in checkbox, unchecked by default**).
   - **`RsPatch.exe` (`msdelta.dll` Patching Client & `.MSP` Compiler Helper)**: Companion static `/MT` C++20 binary-delta engine built on native Windows `msdelta.dll` (`CreateDeltaB` / `ApplyDeltaB`) for compile-time `.msp` synthesis and SHA-256 + `WinVerifyTrust`-verified `Engine = native` delta updates.
3. **Guided Microsoft-Compliant `.MSP` & Major Upgrade Servicing (`--plan-update`)**:

### `v1.0.0 GA` — Frictionless Offline `.rswlic` Edition Paygating, Turnkey CI/CD Automation & Complete 8-Tool RaggieSoft Studio Dogfood Cutover
1. **Frictionless Offline Cryptographic `.rswlic` Licensing (`bcrypt.dll` — Easy License Management, Zero Hardware Fingerprinting, Zero Telemetry)**:
   - **Effortless Activation UX**: Drag-and-drop a `.rswlic` file onto `InstallerStudio.exe`, paste a `-----BEGIN RAGGIESOFT LICENSE-----` text block into **`Editions & Help -> Manage License...`**, drop a file into `%PROGRAMDATA%\RaggieSoft\Licenses\` for IT workstation deployment, or set `RSW_LICENSE_KEY` on headless GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps runners—with **zero hardware/motherboard fingerprinting** (reinstalling Windows or upgrading a laptop never invalidates your key!), **zero online activation servers**, and **perpetual fallback** so expired maintenance dates never brick builds.
   - **Asymmetric ECDSA / Ed25519 Signed `.rswlic` Certificates & Community Attestation**: Verified in `< 0.2ms` via stock Windows `System32\bcrypt.dll` across **Essentials**, **Developer**, **Architect**, and All-Access **RaggieSoft Studio** Suite keys; free **Community Edition (`100% Architect Parity`)** unlocks offline via a one-time non-commercial / solo / EDU / OSS attestation while retaining **`Simulate Lower Tier (Essentials / Developer)`** for QA testing.
2. **CI/CD & Package Manager Automation**:
   - First-party GitHub Action (`raggiesoft/setup-installer-studio`), Azure Pipelines task, and `instbuild.exe --emit-winget` (`winget-pkgs` multi-file YAML generator).
3. **100% RaggieSoft Production Dogfood Architecture (All 8 Studio Tools + Consumer Apps)**:
   - **Installer Studio Builds Every Product & Suite**: All 8 RaggieSoft Studio tools (*Installer Studio*, *Accessibility Studio*, *Training Studio*, *Help Studio*, *Document Studio*, *Localization Studio*, *Launcher Studio*, and *Showcase Studio*) ship as proper per-product `.msi` packages under `C:\Program Files\RaggieSoft\RaggieSoft Studio\<Product>\` (keeping sibling consumer apps organized under `C:\Program Files\RaggieSoft\<App>\`), with shared `.rshm` modules auto-discovered by `RaggieSoftHelp.exe` for unified `F1` offline search across all installed Studio tools.
   - **`Showcase Studio` Front-Door Stub -> `.rsis` Single-UAC Suite Chainer**: The RaggieSoft Studio Suite installer uses a `Showcase Studio` interactive front-door `.exe` (`asInvoker`) where users can explore all 8 products, install an individual tool standalone (`ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT` unset), or launch the `.rsis` Suite setup under a single UAC elevation—dynamically adopting any previously installed standalone Studio `.msi` into `ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT=1` under one clean **RaggieSoft Studio** *Modify / Repair / Uninstall* entry in Windows *Installed apps*.
   - Full clean install, upgrade, `.msp` / `RsPatch.exe` delta patch, `RsUpdate.exe` check, silent deploy (`/s`), and uninstall validation across every RaggieSoft Studio tool, *RaggieSoft Launcher*, *StoreTrainer*, interactive *Story Crossroads* book, and *Engine Room Records* supporter archive on clean Windows 11 `x64` and `ARM64` hardware.

## Post-`1.0` Enterprise & Ecosystem Expansion (`v1.1+`)

Once `v1.0.0 GA` is actively powering 100% of RaggieSoft's own software distributions, post-`1.0` releases expand into third-party IT enterprise repackaging and store formats:

1. **Snapshot-Diff Setup Capture ("Repackager") & One-Click Disposable Windows 11 Pro Sandbox (`.wsb`) Mode**: Capture legacy installers inside a throwaway Windows Sandbox VM and emit clean `.rsip` + `.mst` packages without touching the host workstation.
2. **Visual Studio Extension (`.vsix`)**: Syntax highlighting, schema hover tooltips, and right-click packaging inside Visual Studio.
3. **Enterprise System Primitives & Config Patchers**: Declarative `[Service.*]`, `[FirewallRule.*]`, `[ScheduledTask.*]`, and `[JsonPatch.*]` / `[XmlConfig.*]` config stampers (building on `[Environment.*]` non-clobbering `PATH` and `[IniFile.*]` shipped in `v0.7.0`).
4. **In-Process `.MSIX` / `.MSIXBUNDLE` (`AppxPackaging.dll`), `I18N` + RTL & Procurement SBOMs (`--emit-sbom`)**: Native dual-arch `.msixbundle` generation, Sparse Package Identity, 20+ language `.rslang` tables with `WS_EX_LAYOUTRTL` mirroring, and SPDX 2.3 / CycloneDX JSON SBOMs alongside HTML5 VPAT 2.5 reports.
